issue_title: Record shipment mode for customer handoff

approach.summary: Capture and retain the explicit decision that this delivery is an `unsigned demo/internal handoff`, not a `signed external shipment`, and bind that decision to the frozen baseline before later evidence or bundle assembly references it.
rationale: The analysis showed the repository already distinguished unsigned local validation evidence from signed external bundles, so the delivery session needed one recorded customer-facing mode decision.
This remained a business-facing decision because signed external shipment would require certificate material outside git.

Separating the decision from later execution prevented the executor from mixing bundle labeling with unconfirmed signing work, and the recorded outcome now keeps signed shipment explicitly out of scope.
non_goals: Do not run signing or package rebuild steps in this issue.
Do not infer shipment mode from existing docs without an explicit recorded owner decision.
risk_controls: Require the decision record to name the owner/date and reference the exact frozen baseline.
Describe the non-applicable branch explicitly so later bundle assembly has no ambiguity.

tasks.title: Document shipment mode options against the frozen baseline
tasks.description: Summarize the two permitted delivery modes for the chosen build: unsigned local validation handoff versus signed external shipment, including the extra material each mode requires.
acceptance: Both modes are described using the same terminology as `SIGN_OFF.md`.
The frozen SHA/build artifact is referenced in the decision context.

tasks.title: Record the selected shipment mode and owner confirmation
tasks.description: Write a decision record that names the selected shipment mode, owner/approver, decision date, and the exact follow-up obligations that become active because of that choice.
acceptance: One shipment mode is selected explicitly.
The decision artifact lists the exact next-step obligations for the chosen branch.

dependencies: Needs stakeholder/business confirmation when the selected path is signed external shipment.
validation_commands: rg -n "unsigned local validation build|signed external" docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md
conflict_risks: This decision intentionally overlaps `docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md` with the bundle issue; the executor should treat this issue as the reference point for wording and branch selection.
